requirement: A deleted site's name can be built again, and a press refused TAKEN leaves no site row or seat behind

oracle.ref: PR #1104 (fix); fix evidence: Measured on dev 09/10/2026 21:18 UTC: POST /api/sites for e2e-em (deleted earlier) answered 409 TAKEN and left a site row and owner seat with no job and no container; cms-log-pull failed every minute.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0'. A site built, then deleted through DELETE /api/sites/:key (its provision job stays on record), is built again under the same name by the same owner and by another account, with a buildId and without one: 202, a new job id (never the deleted site's job handed back as reused), one site row, one owner seat. A press refused 409 TAKEN on a live site (by its owner with a new build, and by a stranger) changes neither the site nor the seat count and calls no provision. An imported domain deleted and imported again gets a new provision, not the deleted copy's job.
